name: academic-research-hs
description: Multi-agent academic research pipeline hard-wired to the home-still MCP server: deep-research + academic-paper + academic-paper-reviewer + academic-pipeline orchestrator, plus the home-still-bridge routing skill. Forked from Imbad0202/academic-research-skills and rewired so every literature search, citation verification, and integrity gate goes through the home-still local corpus (distill_search, catalog_*, paper_get, paper_download) before falling back to web APIs.
